endorsements.quote: In light of this, it is recommended that the evaluation index system developed in this study be used as the basis for establishing a full–life cycle quality assessment mechanism for HCAI.
This framework should clearly define accountability and responsibility in high-risk scenarios and include mechanisms to prevent misinformation and breaches of privacy.
This can be achieved by refining language logic, setting boundary warnings, incorporating source attribution, and integrating human-in-the-loop mechanisms.

unlisted_practices: Use the Delphi-AHP weighted, hierarchical quality evaluation index system covering health consultation capability, user experience, and ethics and compliance to assess health conversational AI.
Fine-tune health conversational AI on health information elicitation, diagnosis, and treatment recommendation tasks to improve medical accuracy.
Adjust the structure and weighting of health conversational AI evaluation frameworks and refine capability indicators for specific use cases such as triage, chronic disease follow-up, and elder care.
Establish a regulatory framework covering data processing, model outputs, and information usage for health conversational AI.
Promote the evaluation index system into a widely accepted industry framework through supportive policy initiatives.

screen.reason: The study develops a quality evaluation index system/framework for health conversational AI using Delphi expert consensus and analytic hierarchy process (AHP), functioning primarily as a governance/assessment framework rather than an empirical evaluation of an AI tool.
